summary.text: Paul Jacobs is a Republican member of the Illinois State Senate representing District 59, appointed to the seat on June 17, 2026, and is seeking election to a full term on November 3, 2026.
He previously served in the Illinois House of Representatives from 2021 to 2026 and is a business owner and U.S. Navy veteran.

paragraphs.text: Jacobs served in the U.S. Navy from 1965 to 1971.
His career experience includes owning an optometry practice and co-founding Von Jakob Winery.
Jacobs served in the Illinois House of Representatives from 2021 to 2026.
He was appointed to the State Senate on June 17, 2026, succeeding Dale Fowler, and advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.
